notes: Ride the good news: when big good news comes out about something a hero holds, it lets the run build with a trailing stop instead of selling early
Calmer Town Crier: routine analyst notes and small dips no longer count as big bad news
The Day's Ledger: an end-of-day report in the town - every trade, why it sold, and what's still held - saved each day at the close
The researchers read the news: good news lifts a pick, bad news keeps it off the list
The Town Crier checks headlines every 5 minutes: heroes sell on big bad news, researchers rush out on big good news
Researchers and Pip skip leveraged and inverse funds (2x, 3x, 'Bear' funds) that confuse every signal
Every hero has a stop-loss now (smart: sized to how jumpy each symbol is), a 24-hour cool-down after one, and an optional 'let winners build' exit
The Proving Grounds: 19 classic strategies tested on years of real prices; teach the winners to your heroes
An Update button: new versions install from the town or the tray icon, no reinstalling
The town grows from a hamlet to a market town to a city as the guild levels up
